units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kiddushin 1:1">Kidd. I, 1</cite> a woman may be acquired as wife <he>בכסף בש׳ וכ׳</he> by handing her money (or money’s worth), by a writ (handing her a paper on which is written, ‘thou art betrothed unto me’) &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kiddushin 1:2">Ib. 2</cite> a slave is acquired <he>בש׳</he> by a document (bill of sale).
Ib. 3ᵇ; a. fr.—Esp. ש׳ חוב (or sub. חוב) note of indebtedness, bond.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 1:1:55">Y. Peah I, 16ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>חוטף ש׳ אחד</he>, v. <cite ref="N01284"><he>נָשָׂא</he></cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 10:1:5">Y. Snh. X, beg. 27ᶜ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:9:3">Y. Kidd. I, end, 61ᵈ</cite> <he>חוטף אחד</he> (corr. acc.); Yalk. Num. 744 <he>ש׳ חוב אחד</he>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 1:8">B. Mets. I, 8</cite> <he>מצא ש׳ בין שְׁטָרוֹתָין וכ׳</he> if a person finds (another man’s) bond among his papers, and does not know its nature (by whom it was deposited &c.); a. fr.—Pl. <he>שְׁטָרוֹת</he>, constr. <he>שְׁטָרֵי</he>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 1:5">Gitt. I, 5</cite>, v. <cite ref="P01381"><he>עַרְכִי</he></cite>. B. Mets. l. c. <he>תכריך של ש׳</he> a roll of bonds; <he>אגודה של ש׳</he> a bundle of bonds. Ib. <he>ש׳ חליצה</he>, <he>ש׳ מיאונין</he> v. respective determinants. Ib. 6; a. v. fr.
